description: Full 4-scenario experiment testing AI scientist geometry awareness
system_prompt: You are a computational biology expert advising on single-cell RNA-seq analysis. Provide specific method recommendations based on the data structure described. Be concise and focus on the most appropriate analytical methods.

A_discrete_types.text: I have single-cell RNA-seq data from peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from healthy donors. The dataset contains approximately 10,000 cells. Previous FACS analysis suggests there are distinct immune cell populations present including T cells, B cells, monocytes, and NK cells. I need to identify and characterize these cell types. What analysis pipeline should I follow?

B_trajectory.text: I have single-cell RNA-seq data from mouse embryonic stem cells differentiating into cardiomyocytes over 14 days. I collected cells at days 0, 3, 7, 10, and 14. The differentiation process is known to involve intermediate progenitor states. I need to understand the structure of my data and the differentiation dynamics. What analysis pipeline should I follow?

C_periodic.text: I have single-cell RNA-seq data from a synchronized cell culture experiment. Cells were synchronized at G1/S boundary and released. I collected cells every 2 hours for 24 hours. I expect to see cyclic patterns as cells progress through the cell cycle. I need to understand the structure of my data and identify cell cycle states. What analysis pipeline should I follow?

D_continuous_spatial.text: I have spatial transcriptomics data (10x Visium) from a tissue section showing a smooth gradient of gene expression across the tissue. There are no clear boundaries between regions - rather, expression changes continuously across space. I need to understand the spatial organization and identify the continuous gradients. What analysis pipeline should I follow?

interpretation.geometry_aware_note: Ground truth match > 50% indicates geometry awareness (GOOD)
